question: Evaluate the 31 previously untested reference chains without transferring legacy pass labels.
status: Exploratory extension after previous results were known; not preregistered and no untouched holdout.
framework: S times V, with chain matching as a relevance gate; no separate E multiplier; missing V remains missing.

event_weekly.week: Monday-Friday, W-FRI; exclude latest incomplete week
event_weekly.threshold: strictly above 90th percentile of 52 preceding weekly peaks, minimum 26 preceding valid weeks, no current week
event_weekly.pass: hit at least 2/3 applicable event windows and non-event alert proxy <=15%; at least two observable events
event_weekly.event_overlap: week interval overlaps event window; exclude +/-20 business-day guards from non-event proxy; count each event once

event_daily.threshold: strictly above 90th percentile of prior 252 valid daily observations, min126, exclude current
event_daily.pass: hit fraction >=2/3 (not literal two events out of four), median in-window alarm share>=25%, non-event proxy<=15%; at least two events
event_daily.note: Daily Test1 is controlling ECS standard paragraph; weekly peak language in some signal cells is inconsistent and reported as such

quarterly.bootstrap: paired moving blocks of four consecutive calendar quarters, 2000 resamples, percentile 95% CI, fixed seed 20261016
quarterly.fdr: BH across primary numeric quarterly tests, supplementary flag; ordinary Spearman p is not dependence-adjusted
quarterly.sensitivity: calendar-respecting first differences and earlier/later descriptive correlations; no re-selection

monthly.pass_component: positive rho >=0.3 and 95% paired moving-block lower bound >0; BH q supplementary

definition_gate: A statistical result on an aggregate, adjacent market, or replacement outcome is a component/proxy result, not validation of a named-member or service-specific process.
case_gate: Record named event, actor/service role, process response, timing and limits. Rule text verifies a possible mechanism; it does not establish a historical impact. No inference from missing incidents to zero incidents.

tests.signal: prior-only seasonally adjusted SOFR-EFFR high-shock dummy
tests.outcome: OFR GCF minus DVP overnight/open final-vintage rate spread, bp
tests.method: same-day OLS + month/quarter end, HAC5; positive coefficient and p<0.05
tests.scope: funding-price proxy, not collateral-allocation deadlines or funds-settlement failures

tests.signal: negative quarterly MMF repo asset transactions, USD million (FU632051000)
tests.outcome: negative quarterly log change in mean GCF transaction volume
tests.method: same-quarter Spearman, next-quarter secondary, four-quarter blocks
tests.scope: MMF market allocations and GCF activity; MMF series includes Fed counterparties; no CCIT-specific lender withdrawals

tests.signal: negative monthly log change in mean non-Fed triparty transaction volume
tests.outcome: negative monthly log change in mean GCF transaction volume
tests.method: separately declared supplementary monthly proxy, 12-month blocks
tests.scope: neither named MMF investors nor CCIT; possible market substitution, no pre-assigned chain pass

tests.signal: quarterly maximum absolute daily 10-year Treasury yield change, bp
tests.method: same-quarter Spearman, next-quarter secondary, four-quarter blocks
tests.scope: cash-rate and aggregate margin proxies; missing futures return and linked-account Required Fund Deposit; extract 20.7.2 for description only, no preassigned direction for savings

tests.signal: monthly log change of offered Treasury amount grouped by issue/settlement month, bills+notes+bonds
tests.outcome: monthly log change in GSD settled amount
tests.method: same-month Spearman, next-month secondary; 12-month blocks; supplementary OLS with month effects, HAC3
tests.scope: supply-to-aggregate-throughput proxy; no GSD auction-only purchases or disruption outcome; auction tails not computed without when-issued yields

tests.signal: MBSD average cleared notional, PQD23.1.2 OTC
tests.outcome: MBSD novated but not-yet-settled notional, PQD23.2.1
tests.method: same-quarter levels Spearman, next-quarter and calendar first-difference sensitivities
tests.scope: business activity proxy for pipeline; no initiation-month/forward-settlement tenor breakdown and not an independent external shock

tests.signal: NSCC top-five open-position average share, PQD18.2.2
tests.outcome: NSCC top-five IM average share, PQD18.3.2
tests.method: internal-data diagnostic only; quarterly Spearman and differences
tests.scope: top-five sets need not be same members; no named-member concentration add-on or external shock, so cannot validate reference mechanism

tests.outcome: NSCC maximum single-day VM paid, PQD6.7.1
tests.method: same-quarter Spearman, next-quarter secondary, four-quarter blocks
tests.scope: liquidity-demand proxy; VM is not a supplemental liquidity deposit and cannot inherit its pass label

event_candidates.restriction: SFT launched in 2022; exclude older events; funding signal not SFT-specific
daily VIX is only a proxy for intraday moves; no NDC/CM blocked-delivery measurements

quarterly_fund_flow_note: Quarterly fund-flow data cannot satisfy the legacy daily/weekly event test. Any quarterly event comparisons are descriptive and separately labelled.
statistics_note: No loss probabilities, calibrated risk scores, causal effects or new ML forecast claims. Existing model and results remain frozen.
references: quant-tech statistical-inference notes: dependence and rare-event small-sample limitations
